label: London's burning
source: Aidan Burns, The New Highgate Collection (2017 expanded PDF), printed p. 272 / PDF p. 273; compared against The Highgate Collection (2014), printed p. 192. Both causal diagrams visually checked.
notation: Four-person song round. Six-event blocks: P1 opposite/self/self/opposite/self/self; P2 self/left/self/self/left/self; P3 opposite/right/self/opposite/right/self; P4 all self. Anne: P1-P2-P3-P4; Ben: P4-P1-P2-P3; Clare: P2-P3-P4-P1; Daniel: P3-P4-P1-P2. In the diagram's box order A-B-C-D, opposite pairs A/C and B/D; left/right are adjacent clockwise/counterclockwise.
visualVerification: Visually checked 2017 printed p.272 (PDF p.273) against 2014 printed p.192. Both editions show the same four 24-node alternating-hand rows and same causal arrows. Compared the diagram against the four printed song-line sequences and the stated phase order for all jugglers. Read the row arrangement as clockwise Anne-Ben-Clare-Daniel; opposite pairs Anne/Clare and Ben/Daniel.
modelLimitations: The graph represents the song-round timing and causal row connections. The site layout and spatial direction are inferred from the four-person box diagram; the editor does not separately encode positions or animate movement.

label: Rotator
source: Aidan Burns, The New Highgate Collection (2017 expanded PDF), printed p. 279 / PDF p. 280; compared with The Highgate Collection (2014), PDF p. 197. Causal diagram and sequences visually checked in both editions.
notation: Everyone passes four count. Ben rotates anticlockwise through partners Anne, Clare, Daniel; the simultaneous pairs are Anne–Ben with Clare–Daniel, then Anne–Daniel with Ben–Clare, then Anne–Clare with Ben–Daniel. Walking locations do not alter the recurring throw cycle.
visualVerification: The source causal diagram on 2017 printed p.279 and 2014 PDF p.197 has 12 throws per lane. Cross-lane edges occur at the three pass rounds described in the text; all intervening edges stay within each lane.
modelLimitations: Walking path and formation are retained in notation; each throw and causal destination is represented in the graph.

label: Pistons
source: Aidan Burns, The New Highgate Collection (2017 expanded PDF), printed p. 281 / PDF p. 282; compared with The Highgate Collection (2014), PDF p. 198. Causal diagram and sequences visually checked in both editions.
notation: Four count around two squares. Anne and Daniel walk anticlockwise around one square; Ben and Clare clockwise around the other. At each corner each juggler passes to the person facing them.
visualVerification: The 2017 printed p.281 and 2014 p.198 causal diagrams show initial Anne–Ben/Clare–Daniel passes. After four throw positions, the pass edges switch to Anne–Daniel/Ben–Clare; the eight-position graph then closes. Walk direction and square layout are retained in notation.
modelLimitations: Walking path and formation are retained in notation; each throw and causal destination is represented in the graph.

label: Flying trapeze
source: Aidan Burns, The New Highgate Collection (2017 expanded PDF), printed p. 281 / PDF p. 282; compared with The Highgate Collection (2014), PDF p. 198. Causal diagram and sequences visually checked in both editions.
notation: Four count in trapeze formation. Anne and Daniel walk clockwise around one square, Ben and Clare around another; in the trapeze formation each passes diagonally opposite.
visualVerification: The source graph on 2017 printed p.281 and 2014 PDF p.198 repeats after eight throw positions. Its pass edges alternate between Anne–Clare/Ben–Daniel and Anne–Ben/Clare–Daniel.
modelLimitations: Walking path and formation are retained in notation; each throw and causal destination is represented in the graph.

label: Four person benzene ring
source: Aidan Burns, The New Highgate Collection (2017 expanded PDF), printed p. 282 / PDF p. 283; compared with The Highgate Collection (2014), PDF p. 199. Causal diagram and sequences visually checked in both editions.
notation: Four count around an oval. Anne and Daniel stay opposite one another while Ben and Clare walk around them, each passing twice to Anne and twice to Daniel.
visualVerification: The source causal diagram on 2017 printed p.282 and 2014 PDF p.199 contains four pass rounds: Ben–Anne/Clare–Daniel, Ben–Daniel/Clare–Anne, repeated twice. The graph closes after both walkers have passed each stationary juggler twice.
modelLimitations: Walking path and formation are retained in notation; each throw and causal destination is represented in the graph.

label: Dosado
source: Aidan Burns, The New Highgate Collection (2017 expanded PDF), printed p. 282 / PDF p. 283; compared with The Highgate Collection (2014), PDF p. 199. Causal diagram and sequences visually checked in both editions.
notation: Four count. Dosado begins with the benzene-ring pairing. After Ben and Clare make two passes they stop and Anne and Daniel walk between them; after two further passes Anne and Daniel stop and Ben and Clare move.
visualVerification: The source causal diagram on 2017 printed p.282 and 2014 PDF p.199 uses four four-count pass rounds. Its causal edges match the benzene ring; the location and timing of the walking phases distinguish the pattern and are preserved in this notation.
modelLimitations: Walking path and formation are retained in notation; each throw and causal destination is represented in the graph.

label: Three leaf clover
source: Aidan Burns, The New Highgate Collection (2017 expanded PDF), printed p. 279 / PDF p. 280; compared with The Highgate Collection (2014), PDF p. 197. Causal diagrams and source sequences visually checked in both editions.
notation: Four count. The first 16-position diagram section passes Anne–Ben/Clare–Daniel, then Ben–Clare/Anne–Daniel, then Clare–Daniel/Anne–Ben, then Clare–Anne/Ben–Daniel. At the end the source permutes roles (Anne takes Daniel’s, Ben Clare’s, Clare Anne’s, Daniel Ben’s); the graph repeats that role permutation four times so the complete causal cycle closes. The triangle movement and role changes are described separately.
visualVerification: The 2017 printed p.279 and 2014 p.197 diagrams contain 16 event positions and explicitly note the ending role permutation. Expanding that permutation four times yields a closed 64-position cycle; every displayed pass edge and intervening self edge repeats under the role map.
modelLimitations: Walking path and formation are retained in notation; each throw and causal destination is represented in the graph.

label: Sticky triangle
source: Aidan Burns, The New Highgate Collection (2017 expanded PDF), printed p. 283 / PDF p. 284; compared with The Highgate Collection (2014), PDF p. 200. Causal diagrams and source sequences visually checked in both editions.
notation: Four count. The four jugglers cycle through corner/midpoint/midpoint/corner roles around the marked triangle. Corner positions pass to corners and midpoint positions to midpoints; the source movement rules explain how the layout changes between the two pass rounds.
visualVerification: The 2017 printed p.283 and 2014 p.200 causal diagrams show the initial Anne–Ben/Clare–Daniel pairings, then Anne–Daniel/Ben–Clare after the four intervening event positions. The source diagram closes after eight positions; all position changes remain documented in notation.
modelLimitations: Walking path and formation are retained in notation; each throw and causal destination is represented in the graph.

label: The weave
source: Aidan Burns, The New Highgate Collection (2017 expanded PDF), printed p. 284 / PDF p. 285; compared with The Highgate Collection (2014), PDF p. 201. Causal diagram and sequences visually checked in both editions.
notation: Ben sweeps on two count to Anne, Clare, Daniel in that order; the causal graph repeats every six event positions. The walkers move around a figure eight and pass to Ben on six count; route and club color roles are described separately.
visualVerification: The source causal diagrams on 2017 printed p.284 and 2014 PDF p.201 show a six-position repeating graph: Anne–Ben at t0, Ben–Clare at t2, and Ben–Daniel at t4; all other causal edges stay within one lane.
modelLimitations: Walking path and formations are retained in notation; they do not change the causal throw graph.

label: Dresser drawer weave
source: Aidan Burns, The New Highgate Collection (2017 expanded PDF), printed p. 285 / PDF p. 286; compared with The Highgate Collection (2014), PDF p. 202. Causal diagram and sequences visually checked in both editions.
notation: Ben sweeps on two count to Anne, Clare, Daniel in that order; the causal graph repeats every six event positions. The walkers move left and right along their own line and pass to Ben at its ends and midpoint; route and club color roles are described separately.
visualVerification: The source causal diagrams on 2017 printed p.285 and 2014 PDF p.202 show a six-position repeating graph: Anne–Ben at t0, Ben–Clare at t2, and Ben–Daniel at t4; all other causal edges stay within one lane.
modelLimitations: Walking path and formations are retained in notation; they do not change the causal throw graph.
